operations.name: Append datasets to domains

domain_column.description: Column name containing domains (auto-detected if not provided).

csv.description: Return results as CSV instead of JSON.

query_id.description: Append domains from these saved queries, unioned with any file-derived domains.

file.description: CSV or Excel file containing domains.

operations.name: Authorize
operations.description: Authorize

operations.name: Submit a batch of enumeration jobs
operations.description: Submit many enumeration requests at once. Returns a batch id; poll batch results.

source_query_id.description: Saved query id whose stored contacts receive these verdicts

refs.description: Contact row ids, one per request, aligned by index (requires source_query_id)

round.description: verify = first pass, escalate = re-check of unproven

operations.name: Get business firmographic data
operations.description: Returns firmographic data for a domain including company name, status, score, address, phones, social URLs, description, keywords, and industry classification.

operations.name: Bulk match contacts by name or email
operations.description: Match a list of person names and/or emails to contacts in the database. Queries with an email are looked up by exact match first, falling back to name matching. Returns a task ID for async processing. Check status via /contactmatch/status/{task_id}.

queries.description: List of contact match queries to process.

enrich.description: When true, hydrate full contact data from the vector database (costs credits).

operations.name: Bulk match companies by name
operations.description: Match a list of company names from a CSV/Excel file to business domain profiles. Returns a task ID for async processing. Check status via /bulkmatch/status/{task_id}.

state_column.description: Column name containing states, as ISO 3166-2 codes or names.

min_match_confidence.description: Minimum match_confidence (inclusive, 50-100) a match must have to be returned. Defaults to 50, the standard quality floor.

file.description: CSV or Excel file with company names.

operations.name: Cancel ongoing task
operations.description: Cancel a running asynchronous task. Args: task: The type of task (segment, bulkmatch, discogen) task_id: The UUID of the task to cancel request: FastAPI request object auth_info: Authentication information Returns: JSON response: Cancellation status and message

task.description: Task family: discogen, bulkmatch, contactmatch, or segment.

operations.name: Clear default search provider

operations.name: Match contact by name

operations.name: Contacts discover generate
operations.description: Dispatch a BYOK DiscoGen task that discovers contacts at each given company domain. Builds a `test_discogen_prompt.py`-style multi-row query ("Find X. Return A | B | C per line.") from the ICP text. DiscoGen auto-detects the response format and runs the query per-domain with web search enabled. Poll GET /discogen/status/{task_id} for results. BYOK: uses the caller's own LLM and search provider key
